# ReadingGlass

> ReadingGlass is a native macOS utility that translates screen text inside a movable, click-through reading glass. Recognition, translation and background refinement run on the user's Mac.

## Authoritative links
- [Product overview and FAQ](https://chiefinnovator.github.io/readingglass/): requirements, privacy, features and preview status.
- [Source and build instructions](https://github.com/ChiefInnovator/readingglass): Swift source for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 15 or later.
- [Issue tracker](https://github.com/ChiefInnovator/readingglass/issues): bug reports and feature requests.

## Current facts
- Version 0.1.0 is a source-build preview; no notarized installer or Mac App Store release is currently provided.
- Screen recognition uses Apple Vision. Translation uses a locally installed TranslateGemma model. Background refinement uses Core ML.
- Model files are downloaded separately. The translation model download is approximately 2.22 GB.
- Captured images and recognized screen text are not uploaded by the app or written to a screen-content archive.
- Language quality and difficult layouts still require broader validation.

This optional text index is provided for readable discovery; it is not a requirement for search or AI indexing.
